title: Heat Pump Water Heater Rebates in Sacramento 2026: Up to $4,000 from SMUD | HomePowerRebate
desc: SMUD pays $3,000 to $4,000 for a heat pump water heater that replaces gas, set by tank size, and $1,000 for replacing an electric one. Costs, rules and steps.
h1: Heat Pump Water Heater Rebates in Sacramento
lead: SMUD pays between $3,000 and $4,000 for a heat pump water heater that replaces a gas one, depending on the tank size, and $1,000 for replacing an electric tank. The median job cost SMUD customers $6,220, so the rebate covers about half.
cards_intro: These figures come from SMUD's appliance rebates page, which we read on October 2, 2026. The unit must be NEEA Tier III or IV with a UEF of 2.87 or higher, installed by a participating contractor in the SMUD Contractor Network.

cards.note: The base amount for replacing a gas water heater.

after_cards:
What it costs and what is left

SMUD's data for the past 12 months shows a median installed price of $6,220 for gas to electric (range $2,710 to $13,395) and $5,416 for electric to electric. With a 50-gallon tank, the $3,000 rebate leaves about $3,200 at the median. The 80-gallon tank earns $1,000 more but costs more too: its median was $6,800. Size the tank for the household, not the rebate.
sections: SMUD lists the things it sees behind the spread: the installation company, how far the water heater is from the electrical panel, whether the panel has space for more amperage, and whether the water heater has to be moved. It recommends at least three bids. If the panel is full, the Go Electric rebates for a smart panel, subpanel or new circuit pay up to $4,000 when a gas-to-electric conversion is part of the job.

The rebate climbs at 50, 65 and 80 gallons, which tempts people to buy a bigger tank. A larger tank holds more hot water but costs more to buy and takes more space. A household of one or two rarely needs 80 gallons. Ask your contractor how they sized it and what the recovery time is, and check that the model meets the NEEA Tier III or IV list and UEF 2.87.

SMUD's rebate center is at 916-732-7550, and its Advanced Home Solutions team at 916-732-5732. Rebates must be submitted by a qualified participating contractor, who provides the application for your signature. SMUD says the water heater rebate can be stacked with statewide and federal programs, and notes that some contractors offer the rebate amount up front. Compare with Glendale's $4,000 and LADWP's $1,500 to $2,500.

With Sacramento's average January low of 4.7°C over 2015 to 2024 and hot summers, a garage is usually fine for a heat pump water heater, but a very hot or tight space can be a problem. The unit needs air around it and a drain. Ask the contractor for the model's allowed temperature range and clearance, and for the noise level.
The federal 25C and 25D tax credits ended after December 31, 2025. Statewide single-family help is fully reserved and takes requests on hold only.
installers_intro: HVAC and plumbing companies both fit these units. These Sacramento companies have the best Google ratings, listed by rating and then review count. We are not paid to list anyone. SMUD pays only through its Contractor Network, so ask each company whether it is a member.
claim_heading: How to claim the SMUD rebate
claim_steps: Confirm that SMUD is your electric utility.
Choose a participating contractor in the SMUD Contractor Network and get three bids.
Pick a NEEA Tier III or IV unit with a UEF of 2.87 or higher, in the size you need.
The contractor installs it and provides the rebate application for your signature.
The contractor submits the application. Some take the rebate off the price up front.
For a gas conversion that needs panel work, ask about the Go Electric rebate.
faq: How much is the SMUD water heater rebate?
$3,000, $3,500 or $4,000 for a gas-to-electric swap with a 50, 65 or 80 gallon-plus tank, and $1,000 for replacing an electric tank.
NEEA Tier III or IV with a UEF of 2.87 or higher.
